# Audit 06 — Standardized Error Handling and Custom Exceptions

**Audit date:** 2026-09-29 · **Reviewed commit:** `0564118` (main) · **Deployed:** `v1.0.0` (`a00803b`).

Scope: exception boundaries, stable error codes, HTTP/CLI outcomes, safe user messages, logging, recoverable failures; swallowed errors, leaked private details and inconsistent contracts. Custom exceptions are recommended only where they add meaning.

## Confirmed defects (by severity)

| ID     | Sev | Location                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Finding                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Impact                                                                                       | Smallest corrective action                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------ | --- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ERR-01 | Low | [SaveOpportunityEnrichment.php](../../../app/Application/Review/SaveOpportunityEnrichment.php#L60-L91), [RecordOpportunityReview.php](../../../app/Application/Triage/RecordOpportunityReview.php#L94-L136) | Application-layer actions raise HTTP-specific exceptions (`abort(409)` → Symfony `HttpException`; Illuminate `ValidationException`) inside `DB::transaction`. `RecordOpportunityReview` throws `TriageException` for CLI callers and HTTP exceptions for dashboard callers depending on `$dashboardDetails`. The 409 mapping lives in [bootstrap/app.php](../../../bootstrap/app.php#L44-L57) and works, so behaviour is correct; the contract is just split across layers. | Any future non-HTTP caller (job, command) receives HTTP exceptions; two conventions coexist. | Add one `StaleReviewContextException` (domain, `ShouldntReport`) thrown by both actions; map it to `review.stale_context`/409 in `bootstrap/app.php`. Keep the framework `ValidationException` — it is the suitable exception for field errors. |
| ERR-02 | Low | [ImportOpportunityEmailCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/ImportOpportunityEmailCommand.php#L44-L73)                                                                                                | The only command without a `Throwable` guard. Parser failures are handled as quarantine inside the action, but an unexpected `QueryException` (e.g. DB unreachable) propagates to the console handler, which prints the exception message (including SQL with bindings such as the message ID / content hash) and a stack trace. Every other command maps unexpected failures to a fixed code.                                                                              | Inconsistent CLI contract; possible metadata in terminal output during an outage.            | Wrap `execute()` in the same `catch (Throwable)` → `error_code: import.operation_failed` pattern.                                                                                                                                               |
| ERR-03 | Low | [DeadlineAwareImapProtocol.php](../../../app/Infrastructure/Email/DeadlineAwareImapProtocol.php#L143-L150)                                                                                                  | `throwIfDeadlineExhausted()` maps any stream `timed_out` to `mailbox.poll_budget_exhausted`, even when no poll budget was configured (falls back to the 30 s connection timeout). `CheckOpportunityMailboxCommand` never calls `usePollBudget`, so a stalled server during `mailbox-check` is reported as a budget exhaustion rather than `mailbox.connection_failed`.                                                                                                      | Misleading stable code in one path.                                                          | Throw `ConnectionFailed` when `$this->deadline === null`.                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ERR-04 | Low | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L525-L531)                                                                                                         | Final attempt overwrites the actual cause with `mailbox.retry_exhausted` (also listed as REL-06 in [04-reliability-dependability.md](04-reliability-dependability.md)).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Diagnosability.                                                                              | Persist the last cause alongside the terminal marker.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ERR-05 | Low | [OpportunityMailboxHealthCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/OpportunityMailboxHealthCommand.php#L30-L56)                                                                                            | No `Throwable` guard: a `QueryException` from the health queries reaches the default handler (logged with SQL + `workspace_id`/`mailbox_key` bindings — configuration values, not secrets). The other two mailbox commands guard.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Inconsistent; low-sensitivity leakage to the log.                                            | Same guard as the poll command, returning `unhealthy` with a fixed code.                                                                                                                                                                        |

## Accepted limitations (deliberate trade-offs)

| ID     | Location                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Observation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| ERR-A1 | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L270-L274), [L479-L483](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L479-L483), [PollOpportunityMailboxCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/PollOpportunityMailboxCommand.php#L50-L52) | Any `Throwable` (including `TypeError`, `QueryException`) collapses to `mailbox.import_failed`, and the application logs nothing anywhere (grep: zero `Log::`/`report()` in `app/`). A programming error is indistinguishable from a transport failure. This is the documented privacy stance (no raw exception text may reach logs), but there is no _redacted_ diagnostic channel (e.g. exception class name only). Optional: log `get_class($e)` + stable code at `warning` level — class names carry no mailbox data.                                                                             |
| ERR-A2 | Cleanup `catch (Throwable) {}` blocks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L281-L289), [L331-L334](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L331-L334), [L393-L394](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L393-L394), [WebklexImapMailboxClient.php](../../../app/Infrastructure/Email/WebklexImapMailboxClient.php#L307-L309), [CheckOpportunityMailboxCommand.php](../../../app/Console/Commands/CheckOpportunityMailboxCommand.php#L61-L64). Acceptable for teardown; combined with ERR-A1 a persistent close/restore failure is invisible. |
| ERR-A3 | [EvaluateOpportunity.php](../../../app/Application/Triage/EvaluateOpportunity.php#L59-L66), [ImportOpportunityEmail.php](../../../app/Application/Opportunities/ImportOpportunityEmail.php#L118-L126)                                                                                                 | `catch (QueryException)` is broader than "unique violation", but both re-query for the concurrent row and rethrow otherwise — correct and safe.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ERR-A4 | [PollOpportunityMailbox.php](../../../app/Application/Mailbox/PollOpportunityMailbox.php#L437-L439)                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `'email.'.$importResult->errorCode?->value` could yield the literal `email.` if a quarantined result carried a null code; unreachable with the current importer and filtered by `safeErrorCode`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ERR-A5 | Health exit codes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `0` only for `healthy`; `degraded`/`unhealthy`/`never_run` all `1` — documented in the runbook; JSON `status` must be parsed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ERR-A6 | `EmailParseErrorCode::UnsupportedTemplate`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Reserved, never emitted; documented in the project sheet.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

## Review limits

Exception _paths_ were traced by reading; only the HTTP boundary, the CLI health/summary commands and the Playwright error scenarios were executed. Log content was inspected by pattern counts and redacted excerpts only.
